To find the total volume of concrete needed including 7% waste for the continuous footing:

1. **Calculate the volume in cubic feet:**
   - Length = $187\text{ ft}$
   - Width = $2\text{ ft } 7\text{ in} = 2.5833\text{ ft}$
   - Depth = $1\text{ ft } 2\text{ in} = 1.1667\text{ ft}$
   - Volume = $187 \times 2.5833 \times 1.1667 \approx 563.60\text{ cu ft}$

2. **Convert to cubic yards and add 7% waste:**
   - Volume in cubic yards = $563.60 / 27 \approx 20.874\text{ cu yd}$
   - With 7% waste = $20.874 \times 1.07 \approx 22.34\text{ cu yd}$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
